components.name: Link control
components.description: Paper link; the first control uses the featured red treatment.
components.html: InstagramSuivez-nous
components.css: .ds-link { display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:70px;padding:13px 16px;color:var(--ink,#4d2018);background:var(--paper,#fffaf0);border:1px solid var(--line,#d9bda1);border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Trebuchet MS',Arial,sans-serif;transition:background-color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,transform .2s ease; } .ds-link span { flex:1; } .ds-link strong { display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3; } .ds-link small { display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--muted,#7a4b3a);font-size:13px;line-height:1.4; } .ds-link svg { width:20px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--wine,#690b08);outline-offset:4px; } @media(hover:hover) { .ds-link:hover { background:#ffe9af;border-color:var(--red,#a51e1b);transform:translateY(-2px); } } .ds-link:active { transform:translateY(1px); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-link { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview: Warm cream, burger-sign red and yellow frame the supplied logo. The French page feels welcoming and direct.
